findings.title: depositNative says "Swap ETH" but the call only sends native currency to a solver; nothing returns.
findings.evidence: LayerswapDepository.depositNative: `(bool success,) = receiver.call{value: msg.value}("");` Descriptor intent "Swap ETH", interpolatedIntent "Swap {@.value}". Case 0 screen: "Swap 0.1 ETH".
findings.fix: Change the intent to "Send ETH to Layerswap solver" and the interpolatedIntent to "Send {@.value} to {#.receiver}".

findings.title: depositNative intent names ETH on chains where the native currency is BNB, POL, xDAI, AVAX and others.
findings.evidence: Descriptor intent "Swap ETH"; deployments include chainId 56, 100, 137, 43114, 8217, 5000.
findings.fix: Use a chain-neutral intent such as "Send native currency to Layerswap".
